title: Saffron Mechoui Bento
description: A flavorful and savory dish that combines traditional Moroccan mechoui with the delicate flavor of saffron, served in a Japanese-inspired bento box.

ingredients.name: meat substitute (such as seitan or tofu)
bento box ingredients (such as steamed rice, mixed vegetables, pickled ginger)
box spices (such as cumin, coriander, paprika)

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together flour, spices, and saffron threads. Add the meat substitute and mix until coated.
In a large baking dish, arrange the chopped onion in a single layer. Place the coated meat substitute on top.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the onion is caramelized and the meat substitute is cooked through.
Prepare the bento box ingredients according to your preference.
To assemble the bento, place a portion of the mechoui mixture in the box, followed by a portion of the bento box ingredients.
